external_entities.name: members
external_entities.description: People who use the loyalty platform, collect points, and spend them on gift cards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.
external_entities.notes: trust_zone is unknown because the text places members' phones but does not place the members themselves.

external_entities.name: members' phones
external_entities.description: Phones used by members to run the mobile app and retain mobile refresh tokens.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.
external_entities.notes: The text states that members' phones are outside the system's own cloud account.

external_entities.name: partner apps
external_entities.description: Web applications operated by other companies, including a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
external_entities.notes: The apps are outside the system's control and run on the partner companies' own servers.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A member's browser used to sign in and return an authorization code to a partner app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
external_entities.notes: The text does not place the browser in a specific zone.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: The app retains a mobile refresh token on the phone.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: Authorization service that authenticates members, issues authorization codes, refresh tokens, and access tokens, and handles partner consent.
processes.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
processes.notes: It also signs tokens for the support console with the same key used for other tokens.

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: API that reads and writes the points ledger and handles points redemption.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It receives bearer access tokens and writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.

processes.name: partner apps
processes.description: Web applications operated by partner companies that can show a member's points and obtain authorization tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
processes.notes: The same textual name identifies the partner-app external systems and the running web applications; the process represents their application behavior.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: Web application used to close a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account-closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_stores.notes: The database also contains authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and closed-account state.

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: Members use the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: Whether the app sends a PKCE challenge is unknown: 'Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.'

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A member signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser
data_flows.data_description: member sign-in credentials and session data

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.description: The browser submits the member's sign-in and consent interaction to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen that lists the scopes

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: A partner app sends its client secret in the body of a token request to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: client credentials and authorization code token request

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app shows a member's points using the partner API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: manage identity
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and retrieves member identity and authorization data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account state

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger, including redemption transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes each received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: The member's refresh tokens remain in the database when the account is closed.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The system's own cloud account, where the stated platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing members' phones, which are outside the system's own cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps

trust_boundaries.name: partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.basis: The rewards API is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API, and that hostname is described as public.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
